records.official_section: Wizards' Brothers' War release notes explicitly identify reprinted Retro Frame Artifacts with BRR set code in the parent release's Draft, Set and Collector Boosters.
records.evidence_caution: BRR is a bonus sheet of returning cards, not a separately sold premier release; the frozen parent relationship remains BRO.

records.official_section: Wizards' Edge of Eternities release notes identify Stellar Sights bonus sheet cards with the EOS set code within the broader Edge of Eternities product.
records.evidence_caution: EOS is an integrated bonus sheet, not a separate premier booster expansion; individual legalities are not updated by this source audit.

records.official_section: Wizards' All the Expeditions gallery publishes twenty-five Zendikar Expeditions from Battle for Zendikar and identifies them as themed collectible cards in the main product's boosters.
records.evidence_caution: The page establishes the Zendikar Expeditions product subset; EXP is a Scryfall catalog code, not an exact code printed by this article.

records.official_section: Wizards' FINAL FANTASY release notes explicitly identify Through the Ages returning cards with the FCA set code and describe alternate names printed above the Oracle-reference name.
records.evidence_caution: Alternate titles are not separate Oracle identities, and these returning FCA printings do not become independently new Standard cards.

records.official_section: Wizards' Spider-Man collecting guide explicitly prints SPE and MAR as the Marvel's Spider-Man Eternal-Legal Set Codes and identifies the source-material presentation of earlier Marvel characters.
records.evidence_caution: The MAR code covers multiple Marvel source-material contexts; this page does not make it a separately launched main set or certify all later printings.

records.official_section: Wizards describes the Guilds of Ravnica Mythic Edition: a special twenty-four-pack booster box with eight marked packs that each contain an exclusive planeswalker card.
records.evidence_caution: Mythic Edition became multiple named products; the MED Scryfall code must not be interpreted as a single physical box or exact officially printed code.

records.official_section: Wizards' Masterpiece Series: Amonkhet Invocations card preview establishes the named collectible Invocations treatment tied to Amonkhet-era product boosters.
records.evidence_caution: The contemporary Wizards preview supports the named Invocations family, not an explicit assertion that its exact printed Scryfall code was MP2.

records.official_section: Wizards' Masterpiece Series: Kaladesh Inventions introduction identifies premium Inventions artifacts distributed in Kaladesh product boosters as the next Masterpiece treatment.
records.evidence_caution: The official named family evidence is linked to the Scryfall MPS code; the cited Wizards article does not independently print that code.

records.official_section: Wizards' March of the Machine release notes identify sixty-five returning Multiverse Legends cards, collector numbered 1–65, explicitly with the MUL set code.
records.evidence_caution: MUL is a supplemental booster sheet of returning legends; the source does not establish a new independent premier set.

records.official_section: Wizards' Outlaws of Thunder Junction release notes explicitly identify the separate Breaking News treatment with the OTP set code as part of that release.
records.evidence_caution: OTP is not another standalone premier expansion and the cited release-era legality must not be taken as current card-by-card legality.

records.official_section: Wizards' Ultimate Masters release notes document one separately wrapped Ultimate Box Topper card inside every twenty-four-pack booster display.
records.evidence_caution: This is an insert inside an Ultimate Masters display, not an independently marketed expansion; PUMA remains a Scryfall-only code mapping.

records.official_section: Wizards' Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles release notes explicitly identify borderless source material returning cards with the PZA set code.
records.evidence_caution: PZA returning source-material cards do not gain new format permissions merely from reprinting in this product.

records.official_section: Wizards' Secrets of Strixhaven release notes explicitly identify the supplemental Mystical Archive cards with the SOA set code.
records.evidence_caution: SOA is a Mystical Archive card subset, not a separately launched premier set or a complete new-card inventory.

records.official_section: Wizards' official Foundations first-look article explicitly identifies Special Guests Set Code: SPG separately from FDN and J25 in its product guide.
records.evidence_caution: SPG includes guest-card appearances across multiple main releases; the Foundations source is evidence of the code, not a single SPG boxed set.

records.official_section: Wizards' Strixhaven release notes explicitly identify sixty-three Mystical Archive cards with printed set code STA and collector numbers 1–63 in boosters.
records.evidence_caution: STA Mystical Archive reprints retain their existing format legalities; a separate Scryfall code does not make another main set.

records.official_section: Wizards' Wilds of Eldraine release notes explicitly identify Enchanting Tales enchantment cards with the WOT set code in that release.
records.evidence_caution: WOT is a bonus sheet of reprints; inclusion does not make a separate Standard premier set or certify all individual cards.

records.official_section: Wizards' Zendikar Rising release notes explicitly describe thirty Expedition cards with printed set code ZNE and collector numbers 1–30 as the promotional Expeditions set.
records.evidence_caution: ZNE Expeditions are supplemental premium cards; Wizards does not describe the catalog code as a separately sold premier expansion.

records.official_section: Wizards describes 30th Anniversary Edition as a commemorative, collectible, non-tournament-legal product inspired by the original Limited Edition Beta cards.
records.evidence_caution: The product is expressly non-tournament-legal; 30A is the frozen Scryfall code and the official article does not explicitly print that code.

records.official_section: Wizards' Buyer Beware article identifies Collector's Edition cards as gold-bordered, square-cut cards representing the original Beta set, and warns about altered copies.
records.evidence_caution: The original domestic Collector's Edition evidence does not separately certify International Collectors' Edition; CED is a Scryfall crosswalk only.

caveats: The contemporary official sources support named subsets, inserts, collectibles and product-family existence; Scryfall set_type and parent_set_code remain separately attributed metadata.
MAR, MED and SPG can index multiple products or releases; a set code is not equivalent to one sold box or premier expansion.
Wizards explicitly describes 30th Anniversary Edition as not tournament legal; no such exception is generalized to other source rows.
The older International Collectors' Edition code CEI and related historical localized codes remain unreviewed until their own primary evidence is found.
